## Problem Statement
What problem are you trying to solve? Who experiences this problem?

## Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed solution clearly. What would change?

## Evidence & Context
- Have you seen this pattern work elsewhere? Share links or examples.
- Which module(s) would this affect?
- Would this help beginners, practitioners, or researchers?

## Implementation Considerations
- What would be the effort level? (Low/Medium/High)
- Are there any potential downsides or trade-offs?
- Can this be implemented incrementally?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.
